Everything you're looking for can be found with some diligent web searching.
Would you be so kind as to give a friendly nudge in the right direction? I'm not super into electronics, but trying to learn more.

I'd recommend starting with Wikipedia. Search the basics like Ohm's Law and Power Law. I admit you don't really have to know these intimately to put together a simple demo project but it helps a lot in understanding and explaining what you are doing. More importantly, you will know how to keep your project safe.

You really should think about safety when it comes to electronic projects. Kids infer and assume a lot, you have to make sure they keep within safe boundaries.

That said, here are some components you want to look into:

  • blinking led - there are already led bulbs that blink on their own. If you want to make it a circuit, look into transistor or crystal based blinking circuits.
  • switching led circuit - all you need is a power supply, an led and a switch. There's a lot of switches you can use, just visit an electronics parts store. The most common switches for these kinds of projects are dip-switches and tac-switches
  • dimmer circuit - you can use the circuit above but replace the switch with a variable resistor.
